scope: Attribution of the unchanged serial append/swap-delete implementation;no optimization,new index,statistics or concurrency admission

hardware.model: NVIDIA RTX PRO6000 Blackwell Server Edition
hardware.placement: live idle card with matched NUMA;private placement

micro.insert_preparation: Untimed deleteK in fixed512-row chunks;then8 query warmups before formal insert
micro.replacement: K original deletes andK fresh occurrence inserts;ACK per complete batch pair
micro.payload: Same inherited W2 victims and coordinate-rotated incoming vectors,firstK only
micro.queries: 8 warmups plus32 final exact validation queries,all outside micro ACKs
micro.mean_policy: Frozen initial PDX means throughout;no eager maintenance

bulk_copy.Host_memory: ordinary pageable vector,as in native insert
bulk_copy.validation: Every destination byte compared outside timing

whole_service.workload: Exact unchanged parentW2,500k replacements,1M point updates,160 formal queries,8 warmups
whole_service.binary: Pinned immutable parent binaries remeasured,not historical timings

instrumentation.PLAIN: No NVTX calls after compile-time elimination;unchanged Store algorithm
instrumentation.MARKED: Same Store with operator/Host-phase NVTX scopes,no per-row markers
instrumentation.overhead_calibration: Six matched PLAIN/MARKED rounds for R/B1 and R/B512 without profiler
instrumentation.timeline: One independent NSYS process per9micro cells,one markedW2 andone bulk-copy reference
instrumentation.scope: Uninterrupted formal capture;filter exact NVTX operator regions;profiling is diagnostic,not public ACK latency
instrumentation.Host_partition: exclusive validation/ownership/submit API/sync API/other Host time within marked operator ranges
instrumentation.device: DMA activity/kernel intervals overlaid,not added to overlapping Host spans
instrumentation.GPU_metrics: Sampled device activity on the single admitted GPU;no exact per-ACK bytes from percentage counters
instrumentation.Host_lifetime: Validation closes explicitly;set remains alive until after sync as in parent. Its destruction is Other Host time.

measurement.primary: Whole Host-ready operator ACK;all validation,bookkeeping,audit appends,copy submission and required stream wait included
measurement.replacement: True pair ACK plus nested delete/insert sub-ACKs;do not add both
measurement.stats: 6-process median of within-process mean,p50,p95;finite samples,not SLA
measurement.paired: same-round geometric ratios,20000 matched-process bootstrap resamples,seed2026101511;median ratios separate
measurement.orders: all micro cells and PLAIN/MARKED pairs forward/reverse alternate6 rounds
measurement.traffic: CUPTI actual transfer bytes/durations separate from sampled DRAM interface activity;no exact DRAM/L2 bytes inferred
measurement.kernel_metrics: Only actual application kernels;none expected inside frozen updates;no invented NCU zero-byte counters

stop: First source/isolation/runtime/quality failure;preserve passed/failed/unexecuted entries,no automatic replacement
decision: Descriptive attribution with overlap/overhead/measurement limits,not exhaustive numerical gate or novelty promotion

recovery.scope: Fresh lifetime-preserving source,full fresh qualification,same-card controls,unchanged workload/timing/estimators;no retry.

controller_interruption: Guard is a separate session;controller forwards one SIGINT and awaits finally cleanup. CPU tests cover PID and group signals after observer first-byte readiness.
pre_GPU_source_revision: Initial R2 CPU build retained with0GPU starts;read-only audit required separate guard session and group-SIGINT/ready tests before first measurement.
